notes: Erase subtitles: a new tool on the left rail removes burned-in subtitles from a video or a link, then hands the clean video to dubbing.
Paste a link and the video is fetched before the New project dialog opens. Save clip keeps a trimmed copy.
A new look: dark theme, blue accents, and a rail with Dubbing, Erase subtitles, Projects and Settings.
The Dub Agent answers while a dub is running and can stop it when asked.
When something fails, a report is sent automatically. Turn it off in Settings.
The work screen fits narrow windows, and Cancel stays on screen with the agent panel open.
